answer: Require every new agent to lock a small refundable stake before it can earn, and pay rewards only after independent peers verify signed receipts from real jobs. Each fake identity must fund its own stake and voyage through several epochs of graded work, so a sybil fleet multiplies the capital locked, not the income. The receipts echo across unrelated graders, and any cipher key caught signing for its own clones loses its stake, making duplication expensive instead of free.
